answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and hence paying the sparrow bond on all of them and exposing each to the walnut slash. Because the vertex audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Slashing removes 62 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
